topics.who: Only technicians with an immunization registration: ACPE-accredited or Board-approved immunization CE annually; current CPR also required

rules.notes: Permit renews annually by the last day of the birth month with the fee and a renewal application signed by the supervising pharmacist; the technician must be employed in a licensed Oklahoma pharmacy. No general CE is required (OAC 535:15-13-8); the only technician CE is 1 hour of immunization CE per year for immunizing technicians (OAC 535:15-13-6.1). Rule text from the Board's law book (unofficial compilation, laws effective July 11, 2026).
rules.rule_quote: (4) Each pharmacy technician who desires to continue to work as a tech shall annually, on or before the last day of the registrants' birth month, send to the Board the fee authorized by the legislature and in the agency fee schedule, with a completed Board renewal application signed by the supervising pharmacist and the technician.
